Well, I'm an engineer by training, and I believe that we can, as we evaluate data centers and AI, number one, there should be guardrails on how things are financed, transparency on those decisions, making sure that the community is aware of what's happening. [...] So there are a number of considerations, and I think that communities ultimately should be the decision-makers.

Big ideas, great questions, and some seriously bright minds!
